text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

OILSEED TENDER - South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation plans to invite tenders on Thursday to buy 13,000 tonnes of rapeseed meal, 10,000 tonnes of rice bran, 10,000 tonnes of palm meal and 20,000 tonnes of copra, traders said. Delivery was slated for February, March and April.

WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC said it would tender February 18 for 20,500 tonnes of northern spring/dark northern spring wheat for donation to Mozambique. The wheat is for March 5-31 shipment and must have a minimum of 12.5 percent protein.

WHEAT TENDERS - It may be Wednesday or later this week before results are known on Iraq's tender for 50,000 tonnes U.S. hard red winter wheat under the U.N. Food for Oil deal, U.S. exporters said. Exporters submitted offers on Monday and the offers are valid through Wednesday, exporters said. Iraq seeks 25,000 tonnes for April shipment and 25,000 for May.

- Pakistan will hold side-by-side tenders for 360,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat and Australian white milling wheat. Bids for both tenders will be opened on February 16 and must be valid on February 17. Shipment was for March 5-31.
WHEAT TENDERS - Lebanon's economy ministry invited international firms or their local agents to tender to buy on its behalf 35,000 tonnes of U.S. hard wheat for end of March.

- Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade has offered 40,000 tonnes of hard durum amber wheat for sale. An international call set February 12 as the final date for bids had already been issued. Confirmation would be made on February 13.
SOYBEAN OIL - The CCC of USDA said it would tender February 11 for 11,670 tonnes of U.S. bulk crude degummed soybean oil for donation to Peru. Shipment is for March 20 to April 5.
RICE TENDER - Colombia is expected to retender for up to 50,000 tonnes of optional origin rice this week after passing last Friday, U.S. exporters and traders said.

One U.S. exporter said Colombia may reschedule the tender for rice which could be U.S. or Argentine for March/April shipment. But one trader said he heard different reports on the quantity. The tender could be for 36,000 tonnes of rough rice or 24,000 tonnes of milled rice, but it could also be for 50,000 tonnes optional origin rough or milled rice, he said.

RICE TENDER - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs issued a tender to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for shipment in April. March 3 was set as the final date to receive bids and confirmation would be made on March 12.

MARKET TALK - Legislated caps on rail rates for grain shipments are keeping wheat on Canada's Prairies while ocean vessels wait for it on the Pacific coast, grain and transportation analysts said Tuesday.

On Tuesday, 42 ocean vessels were waiting to load grain on the Pacific coast, including 12 destined for Japan. Some had been waiting as long as 39 days. Another 13 ships were due to arrive later this week. The Canadian Wheat Board has already deferred shipment of more than 1.5 million tonnes of grain since early January because of the rail shipment delays. The Wheat Board faces demurrage fines of more than C$15 million along with lost sales up to April.
